name: Bountiful Luck
description: If an ally no more than 30 ft away whom you can see rolls a natural 1 on an attack roll, ability check or saving throw, spend your reaction to let them roll that d20 again. They keep the new result.
After you do, your Lucky racial trait is off limits until your next turn ends.

name: Charger
description: After you Dash as your action, your bonus action can be one melee weapon attack or a shove.
Having moved 10 ft or more in a straight line just before that bonus action, a hit adds +5 damage, and a successful shove pushes the target up to 10 ft away.

name: Crossbow Expert
description: Crossbows you are proficient with no longer need loading time. A hostile creature within 5 ft does not hamper your ranged attacks.
When you attack with a one-handed weapon as part of the Attack action, a bonus action lets you also fire a loaded hand crossbow you are holding.

name: Defensive Duelist
description: While you wield a finesse weapon you are proficient with, you can use your reaction when a melee attack hits you to add your proficiency bonus to AC against it, which may make it miss.

name: Dragon Fear
description: +1 to Strength, Constitution or Charisma (max 20).

You can spend a use of Breath Weapon on a roar in place of the breath. Each creature you pick within 30 ft makes a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier) or is frightened of you for 1 minute. A creature unable to hear or see you succeeds automatically, and a frightened one that takes damage may repeat the save, shaking off the fear on a success.

name: Drow High Magic
description: You learn detect magic and may cast it at will, never spending a spell slot on it.
Levitate and dispel magic join your spells too, and each can be cast once per long rest with no spell slot. All three use Charisma as your spellcasting ability.

spells.uses: Once per long rest, no slot
Once per long rest, no slot

name: Dwarven Fortitude
description: +1 to Constitution (max 20).
Whenever you Dodge in combat, you may also spend one Hit Die on healing: roll it, add your Constitution modifier, and recover that many hit points (at least 1).

name: Fade Away
description: +1 to Dexterity or Intelligence (max 20).

Right after you take damage, your reaction can turn you invisible by magic. The invisibility ends when your next turn ends, or sooner if you attack, deal damage or force a saving throw on anyone. Once per short or long rest.

name: Fey Teleportation
description: +1 to Intelligence or Charisma (max 20).
You can speak, read and write Sylvan.
You learn misty step. You may cast it once with no spell slot, and that free casting returns after a short or long rest. It uses Intelligence as your spellcasting ability.

spells.uses: Once per short or long rest, no slot

name: Flames of Phlegethos
description: +1 to Intelligence or Charisma (max 20).
When a spell you cast deals fire damage, you can reroll any 1s on its fire damage dice, and must keep the result, even a second 1.

Casting a spell that deals fire damage also lets you wrap yourself in flames until your next turn ends. They never hurt you or your belongings, shed bright light 30 ft out and dim light 30 ft past that, and burn any creature within 5 ft whose melee attack hits you for 1d4 fire damage.

name: Grappler
description: Holding someone in a grapple? Your attack rolls against them have advantage, and a creature one size bigger than you no longer escapes your hold automatically.
Spend an action and make a fresh grapple check to pin your victim. Win it, and the two of you are restrained until the grapple is over.

name: Great Weapon Master
description: On your own turn, a crit with a melee weapon or a kill with one lets you spend your bonus action on another melee weapon attack.
With a heavy weapon you're proficient with, you may declare -5 to hit before a melee attack; if it lands, add +10 damage.

name: Healer
description: Using a healer's kit to stabilize someone dying also returns 1 hit point to them.
As an action, burn one use of a healer's kit to heal a creature for 1d6 + 4 plus its maximum Hit Dice count. That creature must finish a short or long rest before the feat helps it again.

name: Inspiring Leader
description: A 10-minute speech to as many as 6 allies (you included) within 30 ft, who must see or hear and understand you, hands each temporary hit points equal to your level + Charisma modifier. Nobody can be boosted again before a short or long rest.

name: Lucky
description: You hold 3 luck points. Spend one on your own attack roll, ability check or saving throw to roll a second d20 and choose which result counts, or spend one when you are attacked to roll a d20 and decide whether the attacker's die or yours is used.
Points spent on the same roll cancel each other out. A long rest refills all 3.

name: Mage Slayer
description: When a creature within 5 ft casts a spell, your reaction lets you make a melee weapon attack against it.
Creatures you damage while they concentrate have disadvantage on the save to keep their spell, and you have advantage on saves against spells whose caster is no more than 5 ft away.

name: Magic Initiate
description: Pick one class from wizard, warlock, sorcerer, druid, cleric or bard. From its spell list you gain 2 cantrips and a single 1st-level spell.
That spell is cast at 1st level only, once per long rest. The class decides your casting ability: Charisma (bard, sorcerer, warlock), Wisdom (cleric, druid) or Intelligence (wizard).

name: Martial Adept
description: You learn 2 Battle Master maneuvers. Your save DC for them is 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength or Dexterity modifier (choose one).
If you have no superiority dice you gain one d6, otherwise you gain one more. They refill on a short or long rest.

name: Orcish Fury
description: +1 to Strength or Constitution (max 20).
Once per short or long rest, when a simple or martial weapon attack hits, pick one of the weapon's damage dice, roll it again and add it to the damage (same damage type).
Right after you use Relentless Endurance, your reaction can make one weapon attack.

name: Polearm Master
description: Take the Attack action wielding only a glaive, halberd or quarterstaff, and your bonus action can be a melee attack with the butt end. That attack uses a d4 for damage, which is bludgeoning.
Holding a glaive, halberd, pike or quarterstaff, you get an opportunity attack on any creature that steps into your reach.

name: Ritual Caster
description: You start with a ritual book holding 2 first-level spells. Pick wizard, warlock, sorcerer, druid, cleric or bard; both spells come from that list and need the ritual tag. That class sets your casting ability. You can cast them only as rituals, with the book in your hand.
Found ritual spells can be copied in when they are on that class list and their level is at most half yours (round up). Each costs 2 hours and 50 gp per spell level.

name: Savage Attacker
description: When a melee weapon attack's damage is rolled, you may reroll the weapon's damage dice and pick the better total. Once per turn.

name: Second Chance
description: +1 to Dexterity, Constitution or Charisma (max 20).

If an attack roll from a creature you can see hits you, spend your reaction to make the attacker roll again. It recharges when combat begins and you roll initiative, or when you finish a short or long rest.

name: Sentinel
description: A creature you hit with an opportunity attack has its speed cut to 0 for the rest of the turn. Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you within 5 ft even when they Disengage.
When a creature within 5 ft attacks someone other than you, and that target lacks this feat, you can react with a melee weapon attack against the attacker.

name: Sharpshooter
description: Long range no longer gives disadvantage on your ranged weapon attacks, and half or three-quarters cover is ignored.
Before a ranged attack with a weapon you are proficient with, you may take -5 to hit for +10 damage on a hit.

name: Shield Master
description: While wielding a shield: after the Attack action you can use a bonus action to shove a creature within 5 ft with it. As long as you aren't incapacitated, the shield's AC bonus also adds to your Dexterity saves against spells and effects that target only you.
When a Dexterity save would let you take half damage, you can react to take none on a success.

name: Spell Sniper
prereq: Able to cast at least one spell
description: Spells that need an attack roll have double range, and your ranged spell attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover.
You also learn one attack-roll cantrip from the bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock or wizard list. The class you take it from sets your casting ability for it.

name: Tavern Brawler
description: +1 to Strength or Constitution (max 20).
Improvised weapons and unarmed strikes count as proficient for you, and your unarmed strikes roll a d4 for damage.
On your turn, once an unarmed strike or improvised weapon connects, your bonus action can go on a grapple attempt against that target.

name: War Caster
prereq: Able to cast at least one spell
description: Concentration saves (Constitution) after you take damage have advantage. Weapons or a shield in your hands don't stop you from doing somatic components.
If a hostile creature moving away earns an opportunity attack from you, your reaction can instead cast a spell on it. The spell must have a 1-action casting time and target that creature alone.

name: Wood Elf Magic
description: Pick one druid cantrip to learn.
You also learn longstrider and pass without trace, and can cast each once per long rest with no spell slot. All three use Wisdom as your spellcasting ability.
